# BlobUploadPurged

`schemas/records/blob-upload-purged.json`

The payload of blob.upload_purged/v1 (docs/design/m1/00-slice-plan.md P2): an expired upload the system actor purged, as it was when set aside (the fields of api/blob-upload). Its upload bytes are gone; the digest may remain in the store if a command published it before the purge.

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `digest` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) |  |

| `uploaded_at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
